caption: The drawing depicts a weather vane centered on a vertical metallic rod. At the top of the rod, there is a small brownish sphere with a dark spike extending upward. Just below this sphere, there is a horizontal arrow: the left end is a simple point while the right end is an ornate, openwork design in dark gray or black. Below the arrow, the intersection of four cardinal direction indicators (labeled "N", "E", "S", "W") is shown with thin black arms in a cross pattern. Farther down the rod, there is a larger sphere, shaded with green, brown, and yellow hues to give a three-dimensional effect. The background is a plain, off-white or cream color. In the upper left corner, there is a small, light pencil or ink schematic that shows a basic outline and measurements of the weather vane's components. The whole composition is aligned vertically within a light rectangular border drawn on the paper.
title: Weather Vane
